question: Does the Quezon advisory label “Upper Umiray” crosswalk to the existing Umiray River lead, and what remains uncertain about the reach?
purpose: Link a dated official advisory name to an existing source-named research lead where name and broad locality context align, while keeping the reach qualifier, route, fish evidence, and current hazard status unresolved.

findings.evidence: Quezon Provincial Government General Flood Advisory No. 14, issued 7 August 2026, lists “Upper Umiray” among Quezon rivers and tributaries likely to be affected by that forecast.
The official 2025 Quezon Ecological Profile page names Umiray River among prominent inland water resources in the Infanta-General Nakar area.

The PRA Boulevard 2000 Integrated Framework Plan, section 7.1.2, page 57, reproduces a historical Umiray-Angat Transbasin Project profile (1991–1999) naming Barangay Umiray, General Nakar and Doña Remedios Trinidad, Bulacan as the project site and Umiray River as its supply source.
supports: historical official project context linking the Umiray River name with Barangay Umiray, General Nakar

crosswalk.resolutionLevel: official name and broad General Nakar locality association; exact “Upper” reach and channel route remain unverified
crosswalk.confidence: The advisory uses the Umiray name and the province profile and PRA project profile independently place Umiray River in a General Nakar context. These sources support association with the existing Umiray River lead, but none defines the exact advisory reach.
crosswalk.mergeDecision: Link the advisory label to the existing Umiray River research lead at name/locality level. Preserve “Upper” as an unresolved reach qualifier; do not create a duplicate river lead or infer route geometry.

reuseAndLimitations: The advisory is dated forecast context and is not current hazard guidance.
The 2025 provincial profile gives a river name and broad locality but no reach, route, coordinates, or fish table.
The PRA PDF is a historical project-planning source; its project-site and supply-source fields are not hydrography or a river survey.
The indexed PRA PDF excerpt was reviewed for page 57; direct opening of the PDF returned HTTP 403. Further detailed extraction requires an authorized accessible copy.
No item-specific reuse license or public-app publication approval was identified for the PRA plan.
No fish presence or absence, salinity, current water quality, access, fishing legality, or safety is inferred.
nextActions: Seek authoritative route-scale hydrography or a Quezon LGU/NAMRIA source that identifies the exact Upper Umiray reach and channel route.
Search dated, station-resolved fish evidence for Umiray River separately; the historical advisory and UATP planning profile are not fish evidence.
nonClaims: “Upper Umiray” is not a verified reach boundary, river centerline, or stable feature identifier.
The historical UATP project-site description is not a map of Umiray River and does not define its route.
The crosswalk does not establish fish occurrence or absence, a complete checklist, salinity, current water quality, current hazard, fishing access or legality, safety, or diet.
